title: The Light Was On — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar trilingual storytelling 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan vocal English Spanish French language learning comedy
lyrics:
[Intro - piano bar, dry delivery]
A moth walked into a dentist surgery
On a Wednesday, around half past three
Took a seat in the waiting room
Picked up a magazine from 1993

[Verse 1 - English]
The receptionist said can I help you sir
The moth said oh no, I am quite alright
I just noticed your practice was open
So I thought I'd come in for the night

[Verse 2 - Español]
La recepcionista dijo puedo ayudarle señor
(The receptionist said can I help you sir)
La polilla dijo no, estoy bien, gracias
(The moth said no, I am fine, thank you)
Solo noté que su consulta estaba abierta
(I just noticed your practice was open)
Así que pensé en pasar la noche aquí
(So I thought I'd come in for the night)

[Chorus - Français]
La lumière était allumée, la lumière était allumée
(The light was on, the light was on)
Pas de rendez-vous, pas de problème, pas de raison
(No appointment, no complaint, no reason)
La lumière était allumée, la lumière était allumée
(The light was on, the light was on)
Parfois la seule raison de venir
(Sometimes the only reason you show up)
C'est que la lumière était allumée
(Is the light was on)

[Bridge - spoken English, dentist dawning]
The dentist said I have to be honest with you
You appear to have all of your teeth
The moth looked up at the halogen lamp
And said — I cannot honestly say

[Bridge reprise - all three languages]
The light was on — la lumière était allumée — la luz estaba encendida
No help needed — aucune aide nécessaire — no necesitaba ayuda
Just the light — juste la lumière — solo la luz

[Outro]
He left without a filling
He left without a bill
The light went off
And the surgery went still
La lumière était éteinte
La luz se apagó
The light was on
